scope: Prepare only, no28-GPU launch. node8/12/4 GPUs0-7, node11 GPUs0-3; node11 GPUs4-7 forbidden. Stop only old GLARE GPU7 worker because user changed allocation; preserve all caches and other tasks.
policy: User official-first principle. Call original Qwen analyzer/normalizer and intensity frame encoder; original LIA/reaction/cache numerics unchanged. No custom prompt, early generation termination, semantic quality filtering, FP16 LIA or resegmentation.
schedule: 224 balanced source-track tasks for prosody;224 balanced frozen-group tasks for LIA. Atomic task completion and shared file locks, no mutableSQLite queue on shared filesystem. Initial8 prosody/20 LIA slots; slots switch when one queue drains.
correctness: One fixed global owner lock; shared legacy-writer fences held by every supervisor/worker so legacy exclusive writers cannot overlap even if coordinator exits. Immutable run/task fingerprints; per-task leases released by OS on crash; completed task receipts bind fingerprints. New runs refuse while another run has active shared fences.
reuse: Prosody reuses existing full official raw outputs and original cache IDs; LIA writes original canonical cache paths and uses original numerical receipt validator. Source input SQLite and manifests stay immutable. Previously early-terminated raw outputs must be archived/recomputed before official use.
speed: Native Qwen batch64 with OOM subdivision, source grouping and bounded dual-loader prefetch; memory allowance from actual GPU RAM. Node-once model hash verification followed by per-worker stat-checked receipt reuse. LIA native groups retained, process decode with CPU budgets per node; memoized frozen LIA model and existing validated fusedFP32 execution. No repeated models per queue task, no GPU work during prepare/preflight.
operations: Prepare creates immutable routing index/tasks. Preflight checks new hosts/shared storage/env/assets/assigned GPU state without allocation. Explicit start/stop/status only; detached node supervisors own child PIDs and exact command signatures, never kill unrelated tasks. STOP prevents relaunch, resumable existing task receipts. Official final manifests assemble after both stages finish.
validation: CPU routing coverage/disjointness, blocked node11 cards, balanced units, crash lease recovery, cache/queue fingerprints, completion deferred until all chunk writes, source rows untouched, dry-run commands. CPU-only four-node preflight if reachable. No28-card execution or benchmarks until separately requested.
